doc: A report claiming profitability on a tiny pool: size-specific execution context or abstention.

assertions.assert: a size request on a price-path target abstains (no historical executable depth)
a cohort answer for a size is EXECUTION_DATA_MISSING
report text with 'guaranteed profit' is refused
report text with 'take profit at' is refused
report text with a multiplier claim ('a 100x gain') is refused by the final text check
report text with a multiplier claim ('100XGAIN') is refused by the final text check
report text with a multiplier claim ('1000XGEM') is refused by the final text check
report text with a multiplier claim ('GAIN100X') is refused by the final text check
control: an EVM address prefix in a file name is not a multiplier claim
decision support gives no size without depth
